body:
If `hit.hierarchy.lvl1` is an array, and you want to display every item of the array, what you do is you replace:

```jsx
<Highlight hit={hit} attribute="hierarchy.lvl1" />
```

with

```jsx
{hit.hierarchy.lvl1.map((_, i) => <Highlight key={i} hit={hit} attribute={["hierarchy", "lvl1", i]} />}
```

so that you are looping over the items in the array, and create a highlight for each of the items in the array, this is similar to doing `hierarchy.lvl1[i]`
